messages.subject: Stream Closed on HDP-2.1
parts:
Hello, 

I've successfully build Rhipe and install it on nodes using HDP stack. There are a few commands that works ok (rhls, rhread, rhwrite...) but I can't run a MR job with a response similar to this unresolved thread https://groups.google.com/d/msg/rhipe/mCxSIcYWxNI/oEDL99KNo1EJ 

The example job I run to get the same ouput as in mentioned thread is

map <- function(a,b)
   for(i in 1:1000)
    rhcollect(runif(1),1)
m <- rhwatch(map=map, reduce=0, input=c(1000,3),read=FALSE)

I also have received a second non-desired behavior if I run the MR job like:

m <- rhwatch(map=map, input=rhfmt('/tmp/x',type='text'),read=FALSE)

This way produces an error like:

---------------------------------
There were R errors, showing 30:

1(1): subprocess failed with code: 127Autokill is true and terminating job_1421774708479_0011
Warning message:
In Rhipe:::rhwatch.runner(job = job, mon.sec = mon.sec, readback = readback,  :
  Job failure, deleting output: /tmp/rhipe-temp-84b1b88ee05296d63b3eb2eb26b2ffdd:


Looking at logs I found that jobs are receiving SUCCEEDED state just before they get killed. I've pasted which I think is the relevant part of the log:
